966 likes, 18 comments - airbnb on October 31, 2026: "A room full of people who make space for others, and @jimmykimmel making space for a few laughs. Thanks for hosting the very first Airbnb.org gala, Jimmy. 

Airbnb.org gives people a place to stay after disasters, during medical treatment, and in moments of crisis. And starting now, stays on Airbnb help house even more people in need.

Learn more at the link in bio.".

1,137 likes, 41 comments - airbnb on October 30, 2026: "Grateful to have our friend @chefjoseandres not only design the menu for our gala, but also speak to the importance of emergency housing.

As part of the evening, we announced that Airbnb now donates a portion of revenue from every stay to Airbnb.org to help provide free short-term housing for people displaced by disaster, traveling for medical care, or facing other crises.

Learn more at the link in bio.".

1,552 likes, 108 comments - airbnb on October 30, 2026: "Your next stay on Airbnb helps provide free short-term housing to people affected by disaster, illness, or crisis. Learn more at the link in bio.".
